title: Quantified laws the spec names (label normalization, count conservation, comparator orders)
description:
Why: of 61 laws only the scaffold's `fast_is_spec` is quantified; the other 60 are closed facts about one value each, so the law side of the project's two equivalences is mostly unbuilt. What: state and prove, over all inputs: label normalization is idempotent; the `count --by-*` groups sum to the total; each list comparator is a total order. Keep the checker's cost in mind: no law may make it normalize a large Peano Nat (a biased Nat OOM-killed PROOF at 16 GB on 2026-09-23). Done when: the laws are proved and cited on the parity board.

title: Phase 5 levers: fast twins bound by laws for decode, repairs, sort and the BLOCKED relation
description:
Why: the port must be usable on real stores. What: for each hotspot of the profile, an experiment card in perf/EXPERIMENTS.md before the change, a fast twin beside its spec twin, a `{fast == spec}` law proved, a cv-gated capture, and a ledger row (a loss goes to perf/NEGATIVE-EVIDENCE.md with a retry predicate). Candidates: a projection twin that decodes only the members a command reads (bound to the full decode followed by the projection), the parallel decode extended to the repairs, an indexed BLOCKED relation. title: Real-store differential sweep through the sandbox (@store directive)
description:
Why: on 2026-09-23 the port was run on copies of this machine's 136 real .beads/issues.jsonl stores (37 KB to 45 MB) and found a bug the 985-case corpus had not (the id prefix rule, H1.1). The corpus is hand-picked; real stores are not. What: add a ws_inner directive `@store=<absolute path>` that copies an external store read-only into /mnt/proj/.beads/ (a harness change: re-capture with --repin and read the MANIFEST diff, which must change no hash), then a driver that runs `count`, `list --json`, `ready --json`, `blocked --json`, `stats --json` and `show <first id> --json` on the original and on the port for every store and reports each byte difference. The stores are not ours to commit: the sweep is a probe, not a golden. Done when: the driver runs over all 136 stores and its summary line (stores, commands, differences) is pasted in PORT_STATE.

title: Profile the load path and remove the quadratic duplicate-id check
description:
Why: every command loads the whole store; batch 5 added `Store.has_id`, which scans the records loaded so far for every new record (quadratic). What: profile a C build on the 1 MB and 25 MB copies (perf, or the keep-audit of the bend2 skill), rank the hotspots, and replace the duplicate check with an id index built once per load. A new fast def is a Phase 5 lever: it needs its spec twin, a `{fast == spec}` law and the BEADS_RUST_SPEC=1 kill-switch. Done when: the hotspot table is in perf/ and the duplicate check is linear, with lanes and PROOF green.
